cases.case: round brilliant, one stone, default Gem mode
cases.expect: one closed cutter body, min_clearance_mm >= 0, volume_mm3 > 0

cases.case: Azure mode drops the upper seat
cases.expect: closed body whose volume is smaller than Gem mode (no upper seat rings)

cases.case: Advanced mode publishes all five builders
cases.expect: closed body; Rotation1..5 and YScale1..5 reach rings 0..4

cases.input: dispatch BuilderGemCutter on one selected gem
cases.expect: document entity count unchanged until Enter; Undo after Enter restores it
